records.text: A Daily Wire producer contacted Maggie Wegner about auditioning for a solo show two days after Ben Shapiro's AmericaFest speech.
records.speaker: Maggie Wegner

appearances.snippet: It reads, Dear Candace, I believe it was two days after Ben Shapiro's speech at AmFest, a producer from The Daily Wire who has been nothing but kind to me, reached out.

verification.notes: Candace reads a message attributed to Maggie Wegner, but the private outreach, timing, and sender identity cannot be independently authenticated.
